verdict.rationale: Neon documents a public Management API at console.neon.tech/api/v2 with Bearer API-key auth, an LLM-addressed endpoint index with per-endpoint pages, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec that probes confirmed is live. It also documents scoped API keys and programmatic project lifecycle management at large scale. missing for 10: an independent or hands-on authenticated API call exercising endpoints (probes only verified that the docs and spec are reachable)

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Management API ships an LLM-addressed endpoint index at docs/reference/api/llms.txt
linking the machine-readable OpenAPI spec at neon.com/api_spec/release/v2.json
Platforms can manage tens of thousands ( in some cases, millions) of projects programmatically through the Neon API.
Project-scoped API Key (Organization administrators; Single specified project)
The `api-keys` command creates, lists, and revokes the API keys that authenticate requests to the Neon API.
